response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and experience with modern software practices, but his background lacks direct exposure to C++ on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, and capital markets/fixed income domains. His diverse technical experience and leadership in open-source projects are assets, but the role's core requirements are not fully met.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with modern languages and frameworks (TypeScript, Node.js, React, etc.).
Proven leadership in open-source projects (e.g., GISCollective) and contributions to developer tooling.
Strong communication skills, evidenced by workshops, talks, and technical writing.
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last noted in 2014–2015) and no explicit Windows platform expertise.
No demonstrated experience with SQL Server or Oracle; SQL skills are listed but unproven in financial systems.
Lacks domain expertise in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income (focus has been on web, mobile, and GIS platforms).
